resources.string: Keep the pairing code window open. Tap Enter code in this notification.

Open phone setup, enable Wireless debugging, then choose Pair device with pairing code. Keep that window open and pull down notifications. Enter the six-digit code in the MM Auto notification, without returning here. If the setting is not highlighted, scroll to Wireless debugging. The notification is temporary; open setup again if it expires.
Allow MM Auto notifications to enter the code without closing the pairing window. Then return here and open phone setup again.
Paired. Tap here to return and check the connection before installing.
Pairing did not finish. Tap here to retry with a new code. Keep the code window open.
Pairing notification expired. Tap here, then open phone setup to start again.
